Question 1
?

A particle moves with constant acceleration. When t=0s, the velocity of the particle is (−2i−8j)m/s, and when t=4s, the velocity of the particle is 2im/s. Calculate the acceleration of the particle.

a
(i+2j)m/s2
b
(2i+4j)m/s2
c
0m/s2
d
4im/s2
e
(i−2j)m/s2
Submit
